large_branch.assumed_pointwise_input: for every nonprincipal chi and every interval I with |I|>=P^(1/4+epsilon_B), |S_I(chi)|<=|I| P^(-delta_B)
large_branch.consequence: large packets satisfy the fixed-power centered convolution L2 saving
large_branch.direct_sup_bound: using the pointwise input on all four factors gives <= P * prod_i |I_i|^2 * P^(-8 delta_B)
large_branch.normalized_l2: after the 1/(P-1) Plancherel factor this gives prod_i |I_i|^2 * P^(-8 delta_B+o(1))
large_branch.not_yet_internal: the current corpus has not supplied a self-contained Burgess proof with constants for all packet intervals

plain_conclusion: 四短区间非主角色乘积矩进一步压成 Burgess 阈值二分。在四个区间都长于 `P^(1/4+epsilon)` 的大包分支中，只要内部化 Burgess 点态角色和节省，就可直接推出固定幂矩节省。所有剩余包对必含一个短于 Burgess 阈值的薄边；这部分不能凭直觉丢弃，还需要一个 Cauchy 尺度下的薄包总质量吸收账本。因此当前自足闭合还剩两个具体子输入：大包 Burgess 内部化与薄包质量吸收。

rows.meaning: 上一证书已把剩余固定为非主角色四短区间乘积矩。
每个矩形包对有四个边长，可按 Burgess 阈值做互斥分支。
若四个边长均超过 `P^(1/4+epsilon)` 且 Burgess 点态界可用，则该包对的角色矩有固定幂节省。
仓库内尚未给出适配全部 dyadic 包的自足 Burgess 点态证明与常数账本。
不满足大边长条件的包对必含一个 Burgess 阈值以下的短边。
仓库内尚未证明所有薄包对总贡献在 Cauchy 尺度下可固定幂吸收。
需要同时内部化大包 Burgess 输入并完成薄包质量吸收，才能闭合四区间角色矩。
本步闭合的是 Burgess 阈值分解和大包充分推导，不是最终角色矩节省。

thin_branch.current_status: not proved in the current corpus
thin_branch.needed_ledger: sum all thin packet-pair contributions and prove they are below the required centered L2 scale by a fixed power
thin_branch.possible_routes: geometric packing of Whitney boundary boxes OR a direct small-side divisor/energy estimate
thin_branch.why_not_automatic: a thin side reduces packet mass, but without an explicit Cauchy-scale mass ledger it cannot be discarded

threshold.burgess_threshold: H_i >= P^(1/4+epsilon_B) for all four sides
threshold.dichotomy: every packet pair lies in exactly one of these branches
threshold.four_intervals: A0,A1,B0,B1 from one dyadic rectangular packet pair
threshold.large_packet_branch: all four intervals are above the Burgess threshold
threshold.polylog_loss: dyadic packet counting contributes only P^o(1), harmless after any fixed power saving
threshold.thin_packet_branch: at least one side is below P^(1/4+epsilon_B)
